Pharma STTM lab

Trace conformed drug history and recover a mixed Gold publish.

All tables and incidents on this page are authored teaching fixtures. The repository paths identify original code. Your draft is saved locally; it is never executed or automatically graded.

1 · Business brief and complete fixture

Alpha sales are ATC category × day, Beta product history is NDC × version, and Gamma reviews are individual events. Preserve these grains and expose one consistent approved Gold run.

ATC codeexample genericclass hint
M01AEibuprofenAnti-inflammatory
N02BAaspirinSalicylate
Product versiongenericclassfromtostaged current?
P1ibuprofenNULLt0t1no
P1aspirinNULLt1NULLyes
P2aspirin and ibuprofenNULLt1NULLyes
P3unknownNULLt1NULLyes

All other product attributes are unchanged and valid. These are authored rows; the original seed has eight categories.

2 · Build and predict

Build

Predict current crosswalk matches for P1–P3. Then enumerate the dimension rows by member type. Does the historical P1 version retain its t0 category under the shown join? What does Alpha sale (D,M01AE,3 units) join to?

Reveal expected state trace
Productcurrent crosswalkconfidencereview decision
P1N02BAexactCurrent staged aspirin
P2M01AEcombination_unverifiedDeterministic tie, not clinical approval
P3NULLunmatchedInvestigate coverage

The dimension has four NDC versions plus two ATC category members = six rows. Both P1 versions receive current N02BA/exact because the crosswalk is joined by product NDC only. Historical-as-of M01AE at t0 is an authored requirement that needs a versioned crosswalk. Alpha sales join the M01AE category member, not a product row.

3 · Operate and diagnose

Operate

Record the run ID and manifest, category key set, one-current NDC count, sales and review grain, confidence distribution, and fact foreign keys. Decide explicitly whether old product versions use historical or restated categories.

Diagnose

Simulated publish interruption: R2 objects all passed nonempty prechecks, then copy stopped after dim_drug. Which current objects are from R2, which are from R1, and what reader-visible risk follows?

Current objectsVisible source run
dim_date, dim_condition, dim_drugR2
fact_sales, fact_review, both wide OBTsR1
Reveal reference diagnosis

Sequential copying can expose a mixed current set despite complete R2 inputs. Check per-object source run/digest and copy logs; compare current fact keys with current dimensions. A wrong run ID or stale reader location is another hypothesis to test. Mark the current set unapproved or block readers before repair. This is an authored incident, not a captured run.

4 · Recover and defend

Recover

Choose a safe R1 rollback or an R2 completion under a reader barrier, then state the exact verification. Variation: category-row count is unchanged, but M01AE appears twice and N02BA is missing. Which gate catches this?

Defend

Why do category and product members coexist? Does `combination_unverified` select a clinically reliable ATC? What does `min(drug_sk)` do for review names?

Drafts save locally as you type.
Compare reference reasoning

Restore all seven `_current` objects from the last approved R1, or finish R2 only behind a reader barrier after checking already copied objects. Verify one run ID, object digests, ATC key set, dimension current-row rules, fact FKs and grains before reopening. A unique ATC and seed-minus-dimension key-set gate catches the duplicate/missing-category variation; the original count-only test does not. The combination rank is stable but unverified; `min(drug_sk)` prevents name fan-out while choosing an arbitrary representative product. An atomic reader-visible run pointer is an authored prevention design.
